name: dubblestack-clone
//: @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi (via vite -> rolldown) declares these as hard deps but carries no os/cpu constraint, so Linux CI resolves it while macOS prunes it — npm then omits them from the lockfile and `npm ci` fails with 'Missing @emnapi/runtime from lock file'. Declaring them here keeps the lockfile self-consistent. Remove once rolldown fixes the upstream packaging.
